claims.claim: Intersect requests $298,250, equivalent to 1,193,000 ADA, for 12 months of Technical Steering Committee support activities.
The budget is divided into 256,000 ADA for community-facing technical coordination, 832,000 ADA for protocol governance and evolution, and 105,000 ADA for technical review.
Execution of the work packages is contingent on approval of the IntersectMBO budget proposal.
All expenditure will be fully accounted for and any unspent funds will be returned to the Cardano treasury.

The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain submission under the approved Budget Process Framework.
The requested amount does not at submission, alone or in aggregate, breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
Independent audits and assurance for this proposal will be provided by Appold, potentially including deliverable verification, control testing, spend validation, and milestone evidence assessment.

The Technical Steering Committee has not received Cardano Treasury funding within the past 24 months, while Intersect and its committees received 22,385,000 ADA through listed prior governance actions.

Intersect will use Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with a Treasury Reserve Smart Contract, one Project-Specific Smart Contract, named reserve and project addresses, and multi-party admin, leadership, and oversight authorization rules.
The TSC's activities are described as foundational technical governance infrastructure supporting protocol settings, CIPs, hard fork coordination, DRep decision-making, and treasury scrutiny.

summary: The document requests 1,193,000 ADA for Intersect TSC support across three work packages, with smart-contract-based treasury administration, external assurance, claimed NCL compliance, and a dependency on approval of the broader IntersectMBO budget proposal.
